AMENDMENT OF SRI LANKA NURSING SERVICE MINUTE

SECTIONS 6.2.2, 6.2.3.2ii, 6.2.3.3v and 6.2.4.3 of the Sri Lanka Nursing Service Minute published in the ExtraordinaryGazette No. 1837/8 dated 19.11.2013 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, is amended as follows.
By the order of the Public Service Commission,
ANURA JAYAWICKRAMA,Secretary,Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine.
At the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine,No. 385, Rev. Baddegama Wimalawansa Thero Mawatha,Colombo 10,27th September 2016.
Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine
SRI LANKA NURSING SERVICE MINUTE

Twenty five percent (25%) of the annual training requirement will be selected from the applicants who apply onthe basis of the Bachelor of Science (Nursing) Degree. Selected candidates will be enrolled for the 06 months orientationand co-ordination course.

Height should not be less than 04 feet, 10 inches (4 10 ). This provision is not applicable for the graduates who areenrolled for the orientation and co-ordination course on the basis of BSc (Nursing) Degree.

Five percent (5%) out of the total number of recruitments will be for males. However the percentage of recruitmentof males may differ from time to time on exigency of service subjects to the maximum of 5%. This provision is notapplicable for the BSc (Nursing) graduates enrolled for the orientation and co-ordination course.
6.2.4.3 Recruitment on the basis fo BSc (Nursing) Degree

Nursing graduates who successfully complete the orientation and co-ordination course, are recruited for thevacancies exist in the post of Staff Nursing Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Nursing Service in the order of a merit listprepared as follows considering the effective date of the degree and G. P. A.
A. When granting appointments for a group of the same university, the merit list is prepared based on the G. P. A.given by the university.
B. When granting appointments for two groups of the same university or for these who have graduated fromdifferent universities, the merit list is prepared based on the effective date of the degree.
